title: Cricket's Peripherals
description: Adds a slew of new peripherals that fill in many feature holes of CC: Tweaked.
body:
Adds a slew of new peripherals that fill in many feature holes of CC: Tweaked.

- Hard Drive: High capacity external storage which can be mounted like a disk drive. (2MiB by default)
- Data Coprocessor: Has many built in fucntions for compression, encryption, and hashing. Much faster than a lua implementation as the functions are implemented in java.

More peripherals are planned.
